proof_0361.moves: Show X lies in the lifts of the map ring hom by exhibiting X itself as the witness, then discharging map f X = X by Polynomial.map_X; the remainder is simp-generated equality bookkeeping.

proof_0362.moves: A simp/API lemma computing the inverse of the homeomorphism 'multiply by a constant' on a topological torsor; it holds by definitional unfolding of smulConst and symm, closed by rfl. No mathematical step beyond unfolding.

proof_0363.moves: Connectedness of a graph is preconnectedness plus nonemptiness of the vertex type; edge-connectivity already gives preconnectedness, so the proof assembles the Connected structure from that plus the ambient nonemptiness.

proof_0364.moves: Definitional simp lemma naming the value of the inverse of the algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials in a unique-index variable set and univariate polynomials; true by rfl, pure unfolding.

proof_0365.moves: A finite additive group is torsion, so the module structure built from torsion applies; the proof just chains 'finite implies torsion' into 'torsion gives a module structure'.

proof_0366.moves: Wrapper lemma: unfold the Raw tree map to its internal implementation, extract the well-formedness proof via WF.out, and apply the corresponding Internal.Impl theorem. All the mathematical content lives in the Impl lemma.

proof_0367.moves: Same wrapper pattern: pass to the inner implementation tree, unwrap the well-formedness hypothesis with WF.out, and invoke Internal.Impl.getD_modify. No independent content.

proof_0368.moves: A hash set is a hash map to Unit, so the size-after-bulk-insert formula transfers directly from the ExtHashMap insertManyIfNewUnit lemma; the pairwise-distinctness hypothesis on the list is what makes the count exact.

proof_0369.moves: Translate uniform summability on a set into uniform convergence of the net of partial sums over finite subsets, apply monotonicity of uniform convergence under shrinking the set, then translate back through the same characterization.

proof_0370.moves: The real-to-EReal coercion is a constructor injection and toReal is defined by matching on it, so the round trip is true by definitional reduction; proof is rfl.

proof_0371.moves: For G ≤ G', the induced map on connected components is surjective, so cardinality of components can only drop; apply the counting lemma for surjections from Nat.card.

proof_0372.moves: The product of two closed sets, as a bundled Closeds element, has underlying set the product of the underlying sets — true by construction of the SProd instance, so rfl.

proof_0373.moves: Specialize the version stated for a set contained in a compact set by taking the compact set to be the set itself, i.e. feed in the reflexive inclusion s ⊆ s.

proof_0374.moves: Read multiplication as scalar multiplication of the algebra on itself and quote the locally-uniform convergence result for smul; the only idea is the mul-as-smul reinterpretation.

proof_0375.moves: Use the characterization of a.e. equality of intersections componentwise: s ∩ t =ᵐ univ ∩ t follows from s =ᵐ univ together with t =ᵐ t, then rewrite univ ∩ t = t.

proof_0376.moves: A global integral curve is an integral curve on any set: at each point of the set, upgrade the (unrestricted) derivative statement to the within-set one.

proof_0377.moves: Rewrite the union of a countable family of sets as an indexed union over the family itself, then apply the already-proved congruence criterion for restrictions to a countable indexed union.

proof_0378.moves: Membership in the orthogonal complement of a closed submodule is by definition membership in the orthogonal complement of the underlying submodule; the statement is true by Iff.rfl, pure definitional unfolding.

proof_0379.moves: Positivity of both arguments gives 0 < min a b (via lt_min), and the arithmetic-geometric mean dominates the min, so chain the strict inequality with the weak one.

proof_0380.moves: Apply the iff-characterization of when separable degree is additive over a product, choosing the disjunct satisfied by coprime polynomials (they share no repeated/common factor), and conclude the additivity.

proof_0381.moves: The ball of radius the distance to the complement is contained in the complement of the complement; rewrite double complement away to land in the set itself.

proof_0382.moves: The cells of a subcomplex form a subtype of the cells of the ambient complex; finiteness of the ambient cell index set in each dimension therefore restricts to the subcomplex, giving the FiniteType structure.

proof_0383.moves: Cancellation on the left is cancellation on the right after commuting the sums; rewrite with commutativity of measure addition and quote the right-cancellation lemma (which needs sigma-finiteness of the cancelled measure).

proof_0384.moves: The norm is continuous, hence tends to the norm of the limit; compose that with the given convergence of f along the filter.
